exposure: Referral status (referred vs. non-referred obstetric cases)
cohort: The study included 300 pregnant women admitted for delivery, equally divided into referred and non-referred groups.
finding: Referred obstetric cases experienced significantly higher rates of Cesarean delivery, postpartum hemorrhage, ICU admissions, and mortality compared to non-referred cases.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was significantly higher in referred cases (68%) compared to non-referred cases (42%).
